sheridan: Hey all — Sheridan (PM, Growth). Day 2 and hitting a few onboarding snags: 1) getting a 403 on the Growth Figma board, 2) where's the canonical product roadmap, and 3) who owns the research templates? Short pointers appreciated.

elaine: welcome! :tada: Roadmap is in Notion (Product > Roadmap): https://redwood.notion.site/Product-Roadmap. Research playbook + templates live at https://redwood.notion.site/research-playbook. For Figma perms, ping design-ops or drop the file link here.

kevin: i'm kevin from design-ops, i'll take the Figma bit. post the file url + your company email and i'll invite you. We also have a self-serve access page: https://redwood.tools/access-requests if you prefer.

sheridan: file: https://www.figma.com/file/PLGrowth/rdw-growth?node-id=0%3A1 ; email: sheridan@redwood.com

kevin: invited you as Viewer. If you still see 403 try clearing the SSO cookie and restart the browser. mac quick fix:
`rm -rf ~/Library/Caches/figma && open "https://accounts.redwood.com/sso" && pkill -f "Chromium"`
should flip the token.

sheridan: that did it 44c can open the board now, thanks!

elaine: design crits are Tues 10am PT (recurring). There's also a New Hires: Product intro recording — watch the 20-min segment on priorities and cadence.

sheridan: perfect. last Q: research templates — can someone DM me the quick interview script + consent wording? planning 5 micro-interviews next week.

kevin: dropped the templates into #prod-templates and shared the Notion page with you. Also added you to the Design Growth team so you can duplicate frames.

design-ops-bot: Sheridan has been provisioned to: Product Team, Design Growth. Onboarding checklist updated (Tasks: read playbook, join crits, confirm Figma access).

sheridan: huge help, thank you all! I201ll start scheduling interviews and sync with research ops.
